reading.title: The Toy Shop Window
reading.purpose: Picture a toy shop window using describing words.
paras: Look in the toy shop window. An enormous teddy bear sits in the back. A tiny wooden mouse sits at its feet.
A shiny red car rolls on a narrow track. The track goes over a curved bridge. The bridge is smooth and painted blue.

qs.q: The mouse is tiny. What does tiny mean?
qs.why: Tiny means very, very small, like the little wooden mouse.
The reading says a shiny red car rolls on the track.

qs.q: Which word tells the shape of the bridge?
qs.why: The reading says the track goes over a curved bridge.

reading.retellFrame: In the window I see an ___ bear and a ___ mouse.
